question: On cold pressing groundnut, oils are released. This indicates the presence of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fats**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cold pressing groundnut releases **fats**, which are a major component of oils.
 
• This process does not release significant amounts of **carbohydrates, proteins, or vitamins**, which are primarily found in other parts of the groundnut.
 
• Cold pressing is a mechanical process that extracts oil without using heat, preserving the nutritional quality of the fats.
 
• Groundnut oil is commonly used in cooking and has various health benefits due to its high content of unsaturated fats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cold pressing** is a method of oil extraction that involves crushing the seed or nut and forcing out the oil without the use of heat.
 
• This method helps in retaining the natural flavor, aroma, and nutritional value of the oil.
 
• Groundnuts, also known as peanuts, are a good source of **monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fats**, which are beneficial for heart health.
 
• In addition to fats, groundnuts also contain protein, fiber, vitamins, and minerals, but these are not the primary components released during cold pressing.
